name: Dong Phayayen-Khao Yai Forest Complex
description: This vast stretch of tropical forest in eastern Thailand links Khao Yai National Park in the west with Ta Phraya National Park on the Cambodian border, 230 km away. Five protected areas make up the site. Its hills shelter more than 800 animal species, including two kinds of gibbon, 392 types of bird, and a breeding population of Indochinese tigers confirmed in 2017.
